newsitem.title: POLAND: BRE to buy financial advising firm.
newsitem.headline: BRE to buy financial advising firm.

text.p: Polish bank BRE SA and British Business Management Finance International Ltd have signed a preliminary agreement for BRE to take a full stake in Polish financial adviser Business Management Finance SA, BRE said.

BRE, whose full name is Bank Rozwoju Eksportu SA, said in a statement on Friday that the Warsaw-based company specialised in privatisation advising, mergers and acquisitions and firm restructuring, and that it had advised the Polish government.
BRE said the move should strengthen its financial advising abilities to clients both home and abroad. It gave no other details.
